name: TMDB Metadata
description: Busca películas y series en The Movie Database (TMDB) y rellena póster, backdrop, sinopsis, año, duración, géneros y valoración.
author: Fork Panel XC

permissions.label: Use TMDB metadata
permissions.description: Search TMDB and import metadata into movies and series

api_key.label: TMDB API key
api_key.description: v3 API key from themoviedb.org (Settings → API). Can also be set with TMDB_API_KEY in config/.env.

language.label: Language
language.description: TMDB language tag, e.g. es-ES, en-US, pt-BR
